name: Philip J. Fulton
tagline: Top rated Workers' Compensation attorney in Columbus, Ohio
about: Attorney Philip J. Fulton has represented injured workers and victims of disability for more than 30 years. He is frequently asked to lecture to attorneys, legal groups and doctors all over Ohio on issues dealing with workers' compensation. He is also the author of the well-known treatise on workers' compensation, "Ohio Workers' Compensation Law," which is used by workers' compensation attorneys, doctors, the Ohio Bureau of Workers' Compensation, the Ohio Industrial Commission and the court system. His firm, Philip J. Fulton Law Office is located in Columbus, Ohio.

For his commitment to injured workers, Mr. Fulton was given the Distinguished Service Award in 1994 and 2002 by the Ohio Academy of Trial Lawyers and was inducted into the Ohio Academy of Trial Lawyers' Association Workers' Compensation Hall of Fame in 1997. A graduate of the Ohio State University and Capital University Law School, Mr. Fulton is an adjunct professor at the Capital University Law School in Ohio where he teaches workers' compensation law.
